sections.title: cosine_similarity()
sections.body:
Calculate cosine similarity

```python
def cosine_similarity(v1, v2):
    """Calculate cosine similarity"""
    return np.dot(v1, v2) / (np.linalg.norm(v1) * np.linalg.norm(v2))

sim_12 = cosine_similarity(user1, user2)
sim_13 = cosine_similarity(user1, user3)
sim_23 = cosine_similarity(user2, user3)

print("\nCosine Similarities:")
print(f"User 1 ↔ User 2: {sim_12:.4f}")
print(f"User 1 ↔ User 3: {sim_13:.4f}")
print(f"User 2 ↔ User 3: {sim_23:.4f}")

# Find most similar
similarities = {'1-2': sim_12, '1-3': sim_13, '2-3': sim_23}
most_similar = max(similarities, key=similarities.get)

print(f"\nMost similar users: {most_similar} (similarity: {similarities[most_similar]:.4f})")
print("\nInterpretation:")
print("  Users 1 and 2 have most similar taste (both rate movies 1 and 4 highly)")
print("  User 3 is different (rates movie 4 highly but others low)")
```

sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- Standardize to mean=0, std=1
- EXERCISE 9: Projection…
- EXERCISE 10: Change of Basis…
- Standardization formula: z = (x - mean) / std
- Projection formula: proj_u(v) = (v · u / u · u) * u
- Form basis matrix and solve
- Solve B @ c = v for coefficients c
- Components in new basis

Standardize to mean=0, std=1

```python
# Standardization formula: z = (x - mean) / std
def standardize(data):
    """Standardize to mean=0, std=1"""
    mean = np.mean(data)
    std = np.std(data)
    return (data - mean) / std, mean, std

heights_standardized, h_mean, h_std = standardize(heights)
weights_standardized, w_mean, w_std = standardize(weights)

print("\n--- Standardization Process ---")
print(f"\nHeights:")
print(f"  Mean: {h_mean:.2f} cm")
print(f"  Std: {h_std:.2f} cm")
print(f"  Standardized: {heights_standardized}")
print(f"  Verification - Mean: {np.mean(heights_standardized):.10f}")
print(f"  Verification - Std: {np.std(heights_standardized):.4f}")

print(f"\nWeights:")
print(f"  Mean: {w_mean:.2f} kg")
print(f"  Std: {w_std:.2f} kg")
print(f"  Standardized: {weights_standardized}")
print(f"  Verification - Mean: {np.mean(weights_standardized):.10f}")
print(f"  Verification - Std: {np.std(weights_standardized):.4f}")

print("\n✓ Both features now have mean≈0 and std≈1")

"""
================================================================================
EXERCISE 9: Projection
================================================================================
"""

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("EXERCISE 9: Projection")
print("="*80)

v = np.array([3, 4])
u = np.array([1, 0])

print(f"\nProject v = {v} onto u = {u}")

# Projection formula: proj_u(v) = (v · u / u · u) * u
dot_vu = np.dot(v, u)
dot_uu = np.dot(u, u)
projection = (dot_vu / dot_uu) * u

print("\nCalculation:")
print(f"  v · u = {dot_vu}")
print(f"  u · u = {dot_uu}")
print(f"  proj_u(v) = ({dot_vu} / {dot_uu}) × {u}")
print(f"  proj_u(v) = {projection}")

print("\nInterpretation:")
print(f"  Projection onto x-axis: we get the x-component of v = [{projection[0]}, 0]")
print(f"  This is how much of v points in the u direction")

# Visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.axhline(y=0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
plt.axvline(x=0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Plot vectors
plt.arrow(0, 0, v[0], v[1], head_width=0.2, head_length=0.2,
         fc='blue', ec='blue', linewidth=2, label='v = [3, 4]')
plt.arrow(0, 0, u[0]*4, u[1], head_width=0.2, head_length=0.2,
         fc='red', ec='red', linewidth=2, label='u = [1, 0] (extended)')
plt.arrow(0, 0, projection[0], projection[1], head_width=0.2, head_length=0.2,
         fc='green', ec='green', linewidth=2, label=f'proj_u(v) = {projection}')

# Draw projection line
plt.plot([v[0], projection[0]], [v[1], projection[1]], 
         'k--', alpha=0.5, linewidth=1, label='Perpendicular')

plt.xlim(-1, 5)
plt.ylim(-1, 5)
plt.xlabel('x')
plt.ylabel('y')
plt.title('Vector Projection', fontweight='bold')
plt.legend()
plt.axis('equal')
plt.savefig('c:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/ML/01_Mathematical_Foundations/projection.png',
            dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("\n✓ Saved visualization to projection.png")
plt.close()

"""
================================================================================
EXERCISE 10: Change of Basis
================================================================================
"""

print("\n" + "="*80)
print("EXERCISE 10: Change of Basis")
print("="*80)

v = np.array([2, 3])
b1 = np.array([1, 1])
b2 = np.array([-1, 1])

print(f"\nConvert v = {v} to new basis:")
print(f"  b1 = {b1}")
print(f"  b2 = {b2}")

# Form basis matrix and solve
B = np.column_stack([b1, b2])
print(f"\nBasis matrix B:")
print(B)

# Solve B @ c = v for coefficients c
c = np.linalg.solve(B, v)

print(f"\nSolving B @ c = v:")
print(f"  c = {c}")

# Verify
verification = B @ c
print(f"\nVerification: B @ c = {verification}")
print(f"  Original v = {v}")
print(f"  Match? {np.allclose(verification, v)} ✓")

print(f"\nInterpretation:")
print(f"  In the new basis, v = {c[0]:.2f}×b1 + {c[1]:.2f}×b2")
print(f"  Check: {c[0]:.2f}×{b1} + {c[1]:.2f}×{b2} = {verification}")

# Visualize
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
plt.axhline(y=0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
plt.axvline(x=0, color='k', linewidth=0.5)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Standard basis
plt.arrow(0, 0, 1, 0, head_width=0.1, head_length=0.1,
         fc='gray', ec='gray', linewidth=1, alpha=0.5, label='Standard basis')
plt.arrow(0, 0, 0, 1, head_width=0.1, head_length=0.1,
         fc='gray', ec='gray', linewidth=1, alpha=0.5)

# New basis
plt.arrow(0, 0, b1[0], b1[1], head_width=0.15, head_length=0.15,
         fc='red', ec='red', linewidth=2, label='b1 = [1, 1]')
plt.arrow(0, 0, b2[0], b2[1], head_width=0.15, head_length=0.15,
         fc='orange', ec='orange', linewidth=2, label='b2 = [-1, 1]')

# Vector v
plt.arrow(0, 0, v[0], v[1], head_width=0.15, head_length=0.15,
         fc='blue', ec='blue', linewidth=2.5, label=f'v = {v}')

# Components in new basis
plt.arrow(0, 0, c[0]*b1[0], c[0]*b1[1], head_width=0.1, head_length=0.1,
         fc='green', ec='green', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.7, 
         linestyle='--', label=f'{c[0]:.2f}×b1')
plt.arrow(c[0]*b1[0], c[0]*b1[1], c[1]*b2[0], c[1]*b2[1], 
         head_width=0.1, head_length=0.1,
         fc='purple', ec='purple', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.7, 
         linestyle='--', label=f'{c[1]:.2f}×b2')

plt.xlim(-2, 4)
plt.ylim(-1, 4)
plt.xlabel('x')
plt.ylabel('y')
plt.title('Change of Basis', fontweight='bold')
plt.legend()
plt.axis('equal')
plt.savefig('c:/Users/Administrator/Desktop/ML/01_Mathematical_Foundations/change_of_basis.png',
            dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
print("\n✓ Saved visualization to change_of_basis.png")
plt.close()

"""
================================================================================
SUMMARY
================================================================================
"""
```
